source: Native AWS Lambda version publication, immutable snapshots, preconditions, retention and ordering; boto3 HTTPS calls, no mocks

context.account_guard: STS identity compared to authorized account before mutations; serialized account normalized to 000000000000
context.execution_role_permissions: Trust only; no permissions, no inline/managed policy; handler cannot create CloudWatch log groups
context.redaction: Account IDs normalized; Code.Location bearer URLs replaced wholesale, never persisted; credentials remain in memory; other ordering, timestamps and request IDs retained.
context.projection_notes: GetFunction and GetFunctionConfiguration outputs are complete except bearer Code.Location removal. Before/after version inventories project selected configuration fields; all_versions_full_projection and pagination retain complete version outputs. ListFunctions pages retain only the owned function's entries in actual order, with original page counts and markers. CloudTrail resources is omitted where absent in the native event; lookup_resources separately preserves LookupEvents Resources, including empty arrays. Invoke Payload is decoded from the actual returned bytes.
context.capture_continuation: Initial phase encountered a native ResourceConflictException immediately after accepted UpdateFunctionCode PublishTo; owned resources were fully cleaned before resuming with same-name recreation. The earlier error and cleanup observations are retained.

documentation.semantics: Code/config snapshots, CodeSha256 and RevisionId guards, version description override, PublishTo enum.
Immutability, description/config qualification, reserved concurrency exclusion and monotonic sequence numbering.
ZIP update, Publish and PublishTo inputs, immutable published code.
FunctionVersion=ALL includes unpublished and published versions; listing projects fewer fields than GetFunction.
Qualifier-specific deletion, alias reference conflict and whole-function cascading deletion.

findings.label: publication_change_qualification
findings.observed: Unchanged PublishVersion returned existing version 1 with HTTP 201. A PublishVersion Description override alone also returned version 1 and its original description. Changing the $LATEST Description created version 2; changing only environment created version 3. Tag-only and reserved-concurrency-only changes both left publication at version 3.

findings.label: optimistic_precondition_precedence
findings.observed: Wrong CodeSha256 returned InvalidParameterValueException HTTP 400; stale RevisionId returned PreconditionFailedException HTTP 412. When both were wrong, RevisionId won. Both matching guards published version 4; its Description override did not change the $LATEST description.

findings.label: ordinary_zip_latest_published_semantics
findings.observed: PublishVersion with PublishTo=LATEST_PUBLISHED returned InvalidParameterValueException HTTP 400. UpdateFunctionCode with PublishTo and Publish omitted succeeded, updated $LATEST code, and entered InProgress. Combining Publish=true and PublishTo returned the same HTTP 400 publication error but still changed $LATEST from code-a to code-b and entered InProgress; versions 5 and 6 remained unchanged. Failure was not atomic.
findings.scope: Measured only ordinary Python ZIP functions; eligibility and behavior for Lambda Managed Instances are not established.

findings.label: code_update_publication_differs_from_unchanged_publish
findings.observed: UpdateFunctionCode Publish=true returned version 7. Updating again with exactly the same ZIP bytes and Publish=true returned new version 8 with the same CodeSha256. This differs from directly re-publishing unchanged $LATEST.

findings.label: readiness_and_in_progress_errors
findings.observed: PublishVersion immediately after CreateFunction Publish=true and immediately after UpdateFunctionCode Publish=true returned ResourceConflictException HTTP 409. Readiness calls retain Pending/InProgress to Active/Successful transitions. Initial trust-policy propagation failures are separately classified.

findings.label: frozen_code_and_configuration_proof
findings.observed: After $LATEST code changed, downloaded version 5 ZIP bytes exactly matched code-a while $LATEST bytes exactly matched code-b. Native invocations returned code-a/config-a for version 5, code-a/config-b for version 6, and code-b/config-b for $LATEST.

findings.label: qualified_metadata_visibility
findings.observed: GetFunction with either numeric Qualifier or explicit $LATEST returned Configuration and Code, omitting Tags and Concurrency. Unqualified GetFunction returned current tags and ReservedConcurrentExecutions=1. ListTags and GetFunctionConcurrency rejected version-qualified and $LATEST-qualified ARNs with InvalidParameterValueException.

findings.label: version_deletion_and_immutability
findings.observed: Deleting an unused version, repeating that deletion, and deleting nonexistent numeric version 999999 all succeeded with HTTP 204. Explicit $LATEST deletion returned InvalidParameterValueException HTTP 400. Deleting an alias-referenced version returned ResourceConflictException HTTP 409 and left the version and alias unchanged. Qualified code/configuration updates and numeric-qualified PublishVersion returned InvalidParameterValueException; missing-version reads returned ResourceNotFoundException.

findings: Unchanged direct PublishVersion returns the current published version, but successful same-value Description and Environment updates each make a new version publishable.
Uploading identical ZIP with Publish=false makes a new version publishable; logical code/config equality is not publication eligibility.
A publication-only description override survives unchanged republication. A later same-value $LATEST configuration update publishes a new snapshot with the current $LATEST description.
Reverting configuration to an earlier published value creates a new version rather than returning the historical matching snapshot.
Deleting the highest version and publishing without another update creates the next number.
Stale RevisionId still fails on an otherwise unchanged republication.
